units.source_text: 他受到了地面摇撼的冲击，呆立不动。

en.t: He was struck by the shaking of the ground and stood frozen in place.

units.source_text: 从天花板上掉下来的沙，使得周围一瞬间弥漫起了雾气。

en.t: Sand falling from the ceiling instantly filled the area around him with a misty haze.

units.source_text: 停了清沙的活，其影响终于显现了。

en.t: The effect of stopping the work of clearing away the sand had finally become visible.

units.source_text: 找不到出路的沙子，一下子压了下来。

en.t: The sand, finding no way out, suddenly pressed down all at once.

units.source_text: 梁和柱子尽力承受着，痛苦地把关节压得嘎吱嘎吱响。

en.t: The beams and pillars bore the strain with all their strength, painfully creaking at their joints.

units.source_text: 谁知女人一直盯着里屋的门楣，没有一点惊慌失措的样子。

en.t: Yet the woman kept staring at the lintel of the inner room, showing not the slightest sign of panic.

units.source_text: 看起来，压力似乎刚刚到达地基的周围。

en.t: It seemed that the pressure had only just reached the area around the foundation.
